projects.title: GoPrivate EDR
projects.description: An open-source, entirely on-device triple-engine machine learning firewall for Android, built under the Project Trinity initiative. Operates as three mathematically synchronized Neural Networks (XGBoost ONNX, XGBoost+SHAP, DistilBERT) running natively on Android silicon. Zero cloud latency and zero data exfiltration — all inference executes at wire-speed (<3ms) within the OS-level VpnService. The project includes the training architecture, data pipelines, and exported ONNX models that power the Android client.

core_components: Engine A: Network Sentinel (XGBoost→ONNX) — Real-time Network IDS/IPS via 80 flow heuristics (Flow IAT Std, Packet Length Variance) extracted natively through C++ JNI from IPv4 packets. CICFlowMeter-derived feature extraction with <3ms latency. ~98.9% F1-score on encrypted transport layers.

Engine B: Vanguard Static Analyzer (XGBoost+SHAP) — Deep forensic payload analysis of installed applications via compiled AndroidManifest.xml AXML parsing. Detects dangerous permission combinations masked by UI obfuscation. Exports to JSON format for ultra-lightweight Kotlin parsing with SHAP explainability for human-readable forensic reports.

Engine C: NLP Privacy Auditor (DistilBERT→ONNX) — Semantic analysis of privacy policies and EULAs synchronized with AccessibilityService and custom headless Phantom Fetcher. Categorizes text into Data_Collection, Data_Sharing, Security_Retention, User_Choice, Other_Policy. Exported to FP32 ONNX with 510-token hard clamp to prevent native C++ memory segmentation faults.

Hardware Thread Quarantine — Heavy ML models strictly clamped to isolated dispatchers (NlpDispatcher, Dispatchers.Default), guaranteeing zero thread-thrashing or CPU cycle theft from active VPN traffic.
Zero-Copy Streaming — Bypasses JVM String allocation entirely when scanning large binaries. Evaluates byte arrays natively via C++, dropping GC pauses to zero.
Explainable AI (XAI) — All models incorporate SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) and LIME-style perturbation for transparent threat scores and human-readable forensic reports.
optimization_highlights: Hardware Thread Quarantine: ML models clamped to isolated dispatchers, mathematically guaranteeing they never trigger OS thread-thrashing or steal CPU from active VPN traffic.
Zero-Copy Streaming: Bypasses JVM String allocation entirely when scanning large binaries. Evaluates byte arrays natively via C++, dropping GC pauses to zero.
Memory-Safe Tensor Handling: Native C++ arena allocators eliminate OOM crashes during sustained packet inspection at 100Hz.
Token Hard-Clamping: DistilBERT output clamped to 510 tokens to prevent native C++ SIGSEGV crashes during document analysis.
privacy_guarantees: Absolute zero remote inference: 100% of ML execution is isolated in native Android processes.
Strict no-payload inspection policy ensures end-to-end user content privacy.
All telemetry vectors never leave the device — forensic audit trails are stored locally with cryptographic integrity checks.

projects.title: Avaani AI Companion
projects.description: A production-ready real-time conversational AI companion built on a VRM-based 3D avatar system. Features a hardened FastAPI WebSocket backend with four specialized AI modules — Whisper STT, Groq Llama-3.1-8B brain, Kokoro ONNX TTS, and YOLOv8+DeepFace vision — all with biometric face authentication, persistent user memory via Supabase, and enterprise-grade resource isolation through dedicated thread pools for each modality.

core_components: EARS Module (Whisper STT) — Faster Whisper base.en engine with custom VAD, barge-in detection via RMS thresholding, and Intel CPU thread locking to prevent GIL contention during real-time audio ingestion.

BRAIN Module (Groq Llama) — Llama-3.1-8B-Instant reasoning engine with 10-turn short-term memory deque and long-term database recall via Supabase. Personality-prompted for empathetic, non-AI-speak responses with emotional tone mirroring.

MOUTH Module (Kokoro TTS) — ONNX int8-quantized TTS with 100+ voice embeddings, pre-cached voice embeddings, and async warmup on a dedicated daemon thread. Humanization padding of 0.2s after punctuation.

EYES Module (YOLOv8 + DeepFace) — Real-time object detection, emotion classification via MediaPipe FaceMesh, face recognition with cosine similarity thresholding, and 'holding object' inference from 30+ allowed classes.

WebSocket Router (/ws/avaani) — 4-Byte LE binary framing between Chrome MV3 and AI backend, eliminating JSON parse locks. Enforces JWT authentication within 10s, single-session-per-user via server-side dictionary, and max 50 concurrent client capacity.

Biometric Auth Pipeline — 5-angle face enrollment (Center, Left, Right, Up, Down) with MediaPipe FaceMesh stability scoring (min 95%). Face vectors encrypted at rest in Supabase using pgcrypto with per-user salt.
optimization_highlights: Thread-Pool Isolation: Each AI module runs on its own ThreadPoolExecutor (IO=32, STT/Compute=CPU/4, VAD=CPU/2, Vision=CPU/4) preventing cross-modality resource contention.
Zero-Copy Audio Pipeline: 48kHz PCM streams through deque-based VAD buffer directly to Whisper with no intermediate JSON serialization.
Biometric RAM Cache: Face vectors loaded into an LRU-style in-memory cache keyed by SHA-256 digest, with 30-minute TTL across browser tabs.
OOM Prevention: Whisper torch threads pre-clamped via environment variables (OMP=4, MKL=4) before import to prevent allocation spikes.
security_measures: JWT WebSocket Authentication: Every connection requires valid Supabase JWT, verified server-side within 10-second handshake window.
Single-Session Enforcement: Server-side dictionary maps user_id to exactly one active WebSocket, killing stale connections on reconnect.
Encrypted Biometric Storage: Face vectors stored as encrypted blobs using pgcrypto symmetric encryption with per-user salt derivation (auth.uid()::text || '_secure_salt').
Row-Level Security: All Supabase tables enforce RLS policies — users can only SELECT/INSERT their own data.
Barge-In Interruption: Live RMS monitoring immediately truncates TTS playback when user begins speaking, preventing race conditions.

metrics.stt_latency: Sub-500ms end-to-end with Beam Size 1 on Intel CPU

projects.title: CivicLink
projects.description: An autonomous, multi-agent AI pipeline engineered to process, verify, and resolve citizen grievances at scale. Built with a stateful LangGraph architecture, it features Vision-Language Model (VLM) forensics, 70B LLM-powered geolocation, automated OSINT scraping for official contacts, and legally robust draft generation.

core_components: Stateful Agentic Workflow (LangGraph) — A self-healing state machine managing the lifecycle of a grievance. Pauses for human clarification on ambiguous inputs and resumes seamlessly, ensuring zero lost context.
Omniscient Geo-Resolver — Utilizes Llama-3.3-70B to bypass brittle geocoders, instantly mapping hyper-local landmarks to strict Indian administrative districts and municipal hierarchies.
Autonomous OSINT Contact Spider — Deploys Headless Playwright to dynamically geofence and crawl government directories. Extracts and validates official email addresses, updating a Fast-Path DB cache.

VLM Forensic Engine — Analyzes user-uploaded images via Gemini Pro/Flash to extract visual severity context, detect AI manipulation, and merge multimodal data into the Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline.
Legal Knowledge Base (RAG) — Injects relevant local statutes and municipal acts into the drafting process to generate formal, legally sound official correspondence from informal citizen input.
optimization_highlights: Implemented a native SQLite rate limiter and distributed tracing, bypassing reliance on external Redis clusters while maintaining strict API limits.
Architected a Multi-Provider Fallback system (Groq primary, Gemini secondary) functioning as a circuit breaker to ensure 100% uptime during rate limits or API degradation.
Decoupled Next.js UI from backend network constraints via a custom direct-to-cloud ApiClient, eliminating Vercel's 15-second serverless timeout limitations for long-running LangGraph executions.
security_measures: Complete PII Redaction pipeline executed before any data reaches external AI models, ensuring strict DPDP and GDPR privacy compliance.
Immutable Audit Trails generated for every routing decision, confidence score, and dispatch attempt, guaranteeing full transparency for administrative reporting.
DKIM/SPF signed email dispatch paired with idempotent delivery protocols to prevent duplicate complaints from overwhelming government inboxes.

projects.title: Cognit AI
projects.description: A production-ready, decentralized, multi-agent coding assistant built as a VS Code extension with a hardened Rust Tokio backend and Dockerized Chromium worker swarm. Autonomously plans, implements, reviews, and iterates on codebase modifications through a strict 7-phase state machine with human-in-the-loop approval gates. Features tree-sitter AST RAG for cross-file dependency resolution, zero-trust HMAC-signed IPC, memory-aware worker provisioning (50% host budget cap), circuit breaker protection on AI providers, and obfuscated TypeScript extension bundling.

core_components: Orchestrator State Machine — A 7-phase finite state machine (Planning → Implementation → Review → Approval → Fusion → Completed → Error) that drives tasks through code mutation with mandatory human sign-off before disk writes.

AST RAG Engine — tree-sitter-based parser covering 5 languages (Rust, Python, JavaScript, Go, Java). Continuously re-indexes the workspace every 60 seconds, extracting function/struct ASTs into an in-memory HashMap for cross-file dependency resolution.

Brain Daemon (Rust Tokio) — Axum HTTP server and IPC message broker that dynamically auto-builds Docker images via tokio::process::Command, enforces memory-aware swarm capacity (50% host RAM, 2.5GB/worker cap), and annihilates all containers on SIGTERM via tokio-graceful-shutdown.

Worker Swarm (Docker + Chromiumoxide) — Ephemeral Rust agents in isolated containers with strict limits (--memory=2g, --shm-size=1g, --cpus=2.0). Pre-flight DOM-based cookie verification before marking workers as ready.
Zero-Trust IPC Bus — Every inter-process message is HMAC-SHA256 signed with per-worker UUID secrets generated at spawn time. Verified messages only; unsigned containers are immediately terminated.
Circuit Breaker Layer — Dual provider circuit breakers (Qwen/DeepSeek) with 3-failure threshold and 60-second open state, enforcing failover without cascading failures.
Obfuscated VS Code Extension — TypeScript bundled via esbuild with javascript-obfuscator (control-flow flattening, string-array encoding, dead-code injection) for production deployment.
optimization_highlights: Dynamic Docker auto-build: If the worker image is missing locally, the daemon traverses the directory tree via std::env upward walk to locate worker/Dockerfile and builds it transparently.
Memory-aware provisioning: SwarmManager probes host total memory via sysinfo, reserves 50% for Cognit, and auto-scales down worker requests that exceed the budget.
Tree-sitter AST background indexing: Runs on spawn_blocking threads, fully async-compatible with tokio, indexing 5 languages simultaneously without blocking the event loop.
Split-brain ledger: Two separate JSONL files (.cognit_brain_history.jsonl and .cognit_worker_history.jsonl) prevent context pollution between high-level goals and microscopic AST mutations.
security_measures: Zero-Trust IPC: HMAC-SHA256 signed payloads with per-worker UUID secrets, verified at every message boundary.
Container Isolation: Docker enforces --memory=2g, --shm-size=1g, --cpus=2.0 limits with host network mode and no restart policy.
RLS-Enforced Database: All Supabase tables use Row Level Security — users can only read/write their own worker_nodes and license data.
Encrypted Session Cookies: Worker session cookies encrypted at rest using pgp_sym_encrypt with per-user salt derivation (auth.uid()::text || '_secure_salt').
Obfuscated Extension: Production bundle passes through control-flow flattening, base64 string arrays, and dead-code injection to resist reverse engineering.
Graceful Teardown: SIGTERM triggers tokio-graceful-shutdown which annihilates all child Docker containers, preventing zombie Chromium instances.

projects.title: Ssense: Edge Privacy & DPDP Compliance Platform
projects.description: A production-grade, edge-native privacy platform that combines local AI analysis with browser-side privacy controls to help users understand data collection practices and reduce exposure to enterprise-grade tracking. Operations execute entirely on the edge via a 9-billion parameter LLM (Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B) running through a bare-metal Rust Native Daemon, with stealth rootkit injection into the browser's MAIN world to blind hardware fingerprinting scripts before they execute. Features dual-mode auto-failover (LOCAL_DAEMON / CLOUD_SERVER), HMAC-SHA256 challenge-response authentication, and persistent LRU policy cache with 30-minute TTL.

core_components: Edge & Cloud Dual-Mode AI Architecture — On-device 9-Billion Parameter Small Language Model (Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B) fine-tuned via Unsloth (rsLoRA + SimPO) with GGUF / vLLM multi-LoRA deployment. Dual-Mode Failover (AUTO / LOCAL_DAEMON / CLOUD_SERVER) routes to local Rust Daemon for zero-latency execution with exponential-backoff failover to hardened FastAPI Virtual SLM Server.
Deterministic Output via GBNF Grammar — GPT-BNF grammar physically constrains the C++ tensor engine, guaranteeing 100% valid JSON schema compliance (dpdp_schema.json) with zero parsing failures.
Persistent LRU Policy Cache — SHA-256 digest-keyed inference cache (completedAuditsCache with 30-minute TTL) serving deduplicated DPDP audit reports in <5ms across open browser tabs.
4-Byte LE Binary Framing — Ultra-reliable Little-Endian binary IPC framing between Chrome MV3 and Rust Daemon, completely eliminating UI lockups and JSON parse errors.

MAIN World API Spoofing — Injects stealth Proxies at document_start to override HTMLCanvasElement, WebGLRenderingContext, AudioContext, and Navigator.hardwareConcurrency. WeakSet registry masks Proxies as [native code].
Active DOM Node Removal — Goes beyond visual hiding by stripping (el.remove()) offending third-party <script> and <iframe> tracking nodes from the live DOM and scrubbing image tracking URLs.
Network Telemetry Interception — Hooks window.fetch and XMLHttpRequest in MAIN world to abort requests targeting blocked tracker domains and scrub invasive telemetry headers.

Cryptographic Anti-Extraction Shield — HMAC-SHA256 challenge-response authentication with 30-second timestamp window and nonce replay prevention. Active monitoring for systematic distillation or chain-of-thought extraction probing with HTTP 429 throttling and statutory watermark injection.
optimization_highlights: Zero-latency local execution: Qwen3.5-9B runs on bare-metal Rust Native Daemon (llama-cpp-rs) with n_gpu_layers or CPU threads, bypassing cloud entirely.
4-Byte LE Binary Framing: Eliminates UI lockups and JSON parse errors between Chrome MV3 and Rust Daemon, ensuring sub-5ms cache hit response times.
GBNF Grammar Constraints: Physically constrains C++ tensor engine to guarantee 100% valid JSON schema compliance with zero parsing failures.
LRU Cache with Digest Keying: SHA-256 digest-keyed inference cache with 30-minute TTL serves deduplicated audit reports in <5ms across browser tabs.
security_measures: HMAC-SHA256 Challenge-Response Authentication with 30-second timestamp window and nonce replay prevention cache.
Statutory Model Extraction Shield (AntiExtractionGuard) monitors prompt tokens and domain payloads for systematic distillation probing, throttling with HTTP 429 and statutory watermarks.
PII Scrubbing: Regex text redaction and MediaPipe face blurring before any data reaches external AI models.

projects.title: RevExBot: Deep RL Architecture
projects.description: An industry-grade, physically simulated reinforcement learning framework engineered in NVIDIA Isaac Lab. Designed to train continuous control policies for humanoid robotics, this project develops and contrasts two state-of-the-art paradigms: Adversarial Skill Embeddings (ASE) and Mixture of Experts (MoE). It bridges raw video ingestion, mathematical kinematic retargeting, and highly optimized PPO/GAIL training loops on constrained consumer workstation hardware.

core_components: ASE Pipeline (Adversarial Skill Embeddings) — A generalized monolithic policy utilizing a continuous latent space and an AMP-scaled GAN Discriminator. Enables fluid interpolation between disparate skills (e.g., blending combat and locomotion) with minimal VRAM overhead.

MoE Pipeline (Mixture of Experts) — An isolated-specialist architecture that trains discrete neural networks for specific domains (locomotion, combat, dance), orchestrated by a high-frequency Gating Network for specialized task execution.

Universal Motion Forge — A custom C++/Python data ingestion pipeline utilizing CPU-throttled Farneback optical flow and MediaPipe. Applies strict analytical Inverse Kinematics (IK) with stable arctan2 extremity math to generate mathematically flawless URDF trajectories from raw YouTube MP4s.

Universal Motion Model (UMM) — A Split-Head Actor-Critic policy featuring a strictly Causal CNN history encoder for temporal momentum, safeguarding against future-leakage while protecting delicate manipulator (hand) gradients from massive torso torques.
optimization_highlights: Implemented PyTorch Automatic Mixed Precision (AMP) with custom GradScalers directly inside the PPO loop, enabling full Phase 2 GAN training (4,096 parallel environments) on a single RTX 6000 Ada.
Engineered an O(1) step-time Motion Library Manager with zero VRAM fragmentation, safely handling CPU-to-GPU tensor transfers across thousands of frames.

Replaced standard AdamW with SGD + Nesterov Momentum in the adversarial loops to prioritize landscape generalization over rapid convergence, preventing the policy from overfitting to noisy discriminator spikes.
mathematical_rigor: Designed a surgical 'Teleportation Mask' in the Generalized Advantage Estimation (GAE) logic, explicitly hiding environment resets from the Discriminator to maintain strict Lipschitz continuity.
Constructed a deterministic Ground-Truth Visualizer with time-dilation correction and Isaac Lab ActionManager parity, proving analytical IK bounds before expending 48-hour GPU cycles.

metrics.training_stability: Zero NaN gradient collapses via careful atanh clamping and Orthogonal Initialization

projects.title: HackT Sovereign AI Agent
projects.description: A production-ready, zero-cloud sovereign AI agent built as a Tauri desktop application with a FastAPI backend. Operating under Project Trinity architecture, it provides real-time threat detection, AST-based code auditing across 6 languages, LLM-powered assistance using locally quantized Qwen models, and VRAM-aware resource management — all executing entirely on-device without any remote inference.

core_components: VRAM Guard Engine — Real-time GPU memory monitoring via pynvml with context-managed tensor allocation, auto-degradation when pressure exceeds 90%, and watchdog timer for crash resilience.
Quantized LLM Engine — Qwen 3.5 4B model running via llama-cpp-python with q4_k_m quantization, 4096-token context window, and hard 510-token clamping to prevent native C++ SIGSEGV crashes.

RAG Engine (Multi-Store) — Dual-persistence retrieval: LanceDB vector store for semantic embedding search (nomic-embed-text-v1.5) and Kuzu graph database for structural codebase dependency mapping with tree-sitter AST indexing.

Threat Scanner (AST-Based) — Real-time static analysis using tree-sitter parsers for Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Rust, Go, and C++. Detects insecure patterns (SQL injection, hardcoded secrets, unsafe eval) with 1.5s file-watch debounce.

Audio Pipeline — faster-whisper small model (int8) for speech-to-text with VAD, and kokoro-onnx TTS with humanization padding. Thread-isolated audio workers prevent GIL contention during active development monitoring.

Tauri Frontend — TypeScript/React desktop shell with Zustand state management, 45-second boot sequence timeout, and code diff modal with single-click fix application across C++, Rust, and TypeScript files.
optimization_highlights: Zero-cloud inference: Qwen 3.5 4B quantized to q4_k_m runs entirely on-device via llama-cpp-python with CPU-only fallback (force_cpu_mode config).
Thread isolation: Audio, STT, TTS, VAD, and vision workers each run on dedicated ThreadPoolExecutors to prevent GIL contention during active development.
Multi-store RAG: Combines vector similarity (LanceDB) with graph traversal (Kuzu) for AST-aware context resolution surpassing pure embedding search.
Lazy service loading: No circular imports — services are injected via dependency container with async-aware daemon startup and graceful shutdown.
security_measures: Zero-remote inference: All LLM operations execute locally — no API calls to external providers.
Code diff sandboxing: Threat scanner broadcasts suggested fixes to UI; disk writes require explicit user approval via single-click modal.
AST-based threat detection: Tree-sitter parsers identify insecure coding patterns across 6 languages with sub-2-second detection latency.
Signal-aware shutdown: Async SIGTERM/SIGINT handlers ensure graceful daemon teardown without orphaned processes.

projects.title: Krisna: Agentic AI Design System
projects.description: A production-ready, single-GPU (48GB VRAM) conversational AI design agent utilizing a Two-Tier Generation Architecture (Sparse Masked Sketching → Continuous Flow Polishing) with an on-demand Critic Tier for VL-judged design review. Powered by a fully automated, zero-touch 21-stage Data-Forge ingestion pipeline that processes millions of images into training-ready latents with VLM-as-Judge auditing and strict PII redaction.

core_components: Two-Tier Generation Pipeline — Stage 1 (Sketch Tier): 8-step MaskGIT/MAR masked generation with Halton scheduler and token-critic confidence gating. Stage 2 (Polish Tier): Z-Image-Turbo (6B) fast diffusion handoff with region-locked differential refinement, or Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 (20B) for complex semantic rendering.

Dynamic vLLM Swapping — Model tiers (Sketch, Polish, OCR, Critic) are swapped in/out via vLLM's dynamic model loading engine with psutil zombie-process teardown. Only the active tier consumes VRAM at any given time.

Data-Forge 21-Stage Pipeline — Custom Python orchestrator with SQLite WAL-mode manifest for ACID-compliant state tracking. Processes images through fetch → dedup → quality → safety → PII scrub → caption → structure → encode → audit → export with VLM-as-Judge validation at each stage.

Tri-Path Latent Encoding — Every approved image is encoded into four representations: Z-Image fp16 safetensors, Qwen-Image fp16 safetensors, VQ discrete tokens (int16) for sketching, and structural control maps (Canny edges + bounding boxes).

Critic Tier (On-Demand) — Gemma 4 31B Dense (QLoRA via Unsloth) is swapped in only when explicitly requested, never resident during conversation. Generates scorused critiques seeding /ui_critique/ for DPO training.

PII Protection Pipeline — Multi-layer scrubbing: regex text redaction (s05_5_pii_text_redact), MediaPipe face blurring (s03_5_pii_scrub), and URL sanitization for metadata-only datasets (PD12M/CC12M).
optimization_highlights: Tri-path encoding: Single image → four latent representations (Z-Image, Qwen-Image, VQ tokens, control maps) with domain-gated routing via ui_first_ratio configuration.
Dynamic model swapping: Only active tier consumes VRAM; psutil zombie teardown between stages prevents VRAM leaks across millions of records.
21-stage DAG with SQLite WAL: ACID-compliant manifest tracking across fetch, dedup, quality, safety, PII scrub, caption, structure, encoding, and export stages.
URL-list download path: Enables ingestion of metadata-only datasets (PD12M/CC12M with 25M records) that ship as parquet/TSV + external image URLs.
security_measures: Strict PII redaction pipeline: Three-layer protection (regex text, MediaPipe face blur, URL sanitization) with no PII leakage in training data.
License verification agent: Inline check during fetch stage validates dataset licensing before ingestion.
Faiss dedup with CPU fallback: Windows/macOS get faiss-cpu; Stage 2 deduplication runs CPU-only to prevent memory monopolization.
SQLite WAL mode with IMMEDIATE locks: Prevents data corruption during concurrent manifest updates across pipeline stages.

projects.title: RL_Lab: CPU-Optimized Reinforcement Learning Framework
projects.description: A production-ready reinforcement learning framework engineered for stable, crash-resilient CPU training of Dueling Double DQN agents in custom stealth-based environments. Features mathematically rigorous ray-casting LIDAR physics, 6-DOF guard vision cones with wall occlusion, an interactive Pygame visualization with real-time hyperparameter sliders at 60 FPS, and an O(1) windowed evaluation engine with matplotlib report generation.

core_components: Dueling Double DQN Agent — Separate V(s) value stream and A(s,a) advantage stream with LayerNorm for stable CPU training. Double DQN decouples action selection from target value estimation. N-step returns (3-step) with AdamW optimizer and Polyak-averaged target network updates (τ=0.005).

Stealth Environment (Gymnasium) — Procedurally generated 2D maze with seed-based reproducible wall layouts. Ray-casting LIDAR engine using exact slab-method ray-AABB intersection for 16-beam distance measurement. 6-DOF guard vision cones with configurable FOV (60°), vision radius (150 units), and wall occlusion detection.

SyncVectorEnv Architecture — Replaces AsyncVectorEnv with SyncVectorEnv to eliminate Windows multiprocessing pipe crashes and GIL errors. 4 parallel environments run in main thread with sequential stepping for complete crash resilience.

Interactive Render Engine — Pygame-based 60 FPS renderer with triple-buffered surfaces for environment, route memory, and UI. Real-time sliders for sim speed (1-10x), epsilon (0.01-1.0), learning rate (0.0001-0.01), and curriculum difficulty (0-1). Font fix uses 'arial' to prevent garbage character rendering on Windows.

Curriculum Learning System — Adaptive difficulty scaling that progressively increases guard count based on agent performance. Guard count starts at baseline and increments as curriculum_alpha increases, with guard speed scaling based on config.

RLEvaluator — O(1) metrics logging with windowed moving averages (deque-based). Tracks episode rewards, lengths, Q-losses, success rates, epsilons, and curriculum levels. Generates matplotlib visualizations every 5 episodes to preserve rendering FPS.
optimization_highlights: SyncVectorEnv replacement: Eliminates Windows asyncio pipe crashes by running all environments in the main thread with sequential stepping.
CPU-optimized DQN: LayerNorm prevents internal covariate shift, AdamW provides weight decay regularization, N-step returns reduce variance in sparse reward settings.
Ray-casting LIDAR: Exact slab-method intersection computation for precise distance measurements without approximation errors.
Triple-buffered Pygame rendering: Environment, route memory, and UI surfaces rendered separately and composited for 60 FPS performance.

projects.title: TrackChain ITMS
projects.description: An autonomous railway track anomaly intelligence system (Integrated Track Monitoring System) that transforms revenue locomotives into scanning nodes. Fuses 4K 60FPS optical vision, 100Hz 3-axis IMU vibration dynamics, centimetric RTK GNSS positioning, and an EN 13848-1 physics engine to detect flaws at 130 km/h, forecast degradation 90 days into the future, and coordinate multi-agency repair dispatches in real-time. Production-certified with ZERO hardcoded mocks — all waveforms generated via kinematic physics engines, all CV detections via live YOLOv8n forward passes, all anomalies via Isolation Forest estimators.

core_components: Edge Perception Engine — 4K 60FPS Sony IMX477 vision head with OpenCV Canny/Hough pipeline for rail centerline extraction. 6-DOF ICM-42688-P IMU at 100Hz for vibration dynamics. Dual-antenna u-blox ZED-F9P RTK GNSS with ±0.05m accuracy. NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano for on-board inference.

EN 13848-1 Physics Calculator — Computes track twist (τ = |C(z) - C(z-L)| / L) over 3.0m base length, gauge, and cant. Enforces Action Level (AL ≤ 2.0 mm/m) and Immediate Action Limit (IAL > 3.5 mm/m) thresholds with mandatory TSR 30 km/h dispatch.

YOLOv8n Detection Engine — Live neural network forward pass for fastener cracks, rail squats, joint gaps, and surface defects. SAHI (Slicing Adaptive Inference) for high-resolution frame processing. Output: bounding boxes + confidence + class.

Isolation Forest Anomaly Detector — Trained on 10km nominal track profiles. Continuous outlier scoring for geometry anomalies with conformal prediction bands (P10-P90). Sklearn scikit-learn implementation with 90-day degradation forecasting via Weibull survival analysis.

3D WebGL Digital Twin — React Three Fiber renderer with 1,000+ instanced sleepers in a single draw call sustaining locked 60 FPS. TQI vertex-color shaders (Emerald Green → Cyber Cyan → Glowing Amber → Crimson Red). Click-to-sync defect volumes with video waveform lockstep.

FastAPI Async Gateway — 13 REST API routes with Pydantic v2 contract models. TimescaleDB hypertables (1-day chunk partitioning) with PostGIS spatial coordinates. Redis SSE event bus for live alert streaming. Mutual TLS 1.3 gateway with HMAC-SHA256 request signing.
Circular SQLite WAL Buffer — 72-hour zero-data-loss tunnel storage for tunnel disconnections. Automatic sync resumption with idempotent delivery guarantees when re-entering coverage.

Multiplayer War Room — Collaborative incident triage with spatial map pinning, temporal video scrubber flags, zero-asset voice note recording (30s MediaRecorder), and deterministic live demo triggers for SIH presentations.
optimization_highlights: Instanced Mesh Optimization: 1,000+ concrete sleepers rendered in 1 draw call via Three.js <instancedMesh> with individual cant rotation matrices, sustaining locked 60 FPS on standard hardware.

Zero-Mock Architecture: All track geometry waveforms generated via EN 13848-1 / RDSO kinematic physics engines. All CV detections via live YOLOv8n forward passes. All anomaly scores via Isolation Forest estimators trained on real 10km profiles.
5-Stage Distributed Tracing: End-to-end latency = Capture + Transport + Ingest + Inference + Render. 18.5ms stream delivery with sub-millisecond synchronization.
Honest ML Degradation: If YOLO weights (.pt) are physically absent, backend sets yolo_weights_loaded: false, frontend renders honest fallback badges without 500 errors.
Hardware BOM < $600: RTX A6000 / Jetson Orin Nano + RPi 5 edge node achieves full capital cost recovery in under 60 days by preventing a single emergency track block.
security_measures: Mutual TLS 1.3 / HTTPS Gateway with HMAC-SHA256 request signing and scoped JWT authentication.
Nonces and timestamp windows (30 seconds) for all API requests preventing replay attacks.
Idempotent delivery protocols for alert dispatch preventing duplicate complaints in government inboxes.
Zero-Asset Web Audio Synthesizer: Procedural emergency sirens via Web Audio API without downloading external MP3 files.
Strict DEMO ↔ REAL State Machine: Honest ML degradation boundary ensuring zero silent mocks in production.

projects.title: TradeJack: Sovereign Bare-Metal AI Swarm
projects.description: An uncompromising, bare-metal, self-replicating neuro-evolutionary financial organism engineered for NVIDIA DGX Spark (Grace Blackwell architecture, CUDA 13, 128GB Unified Memory). Fuses cutting-edge mathematical perception models (huseinzol05/Stock-Prediction-Models) with sovereign, self-modifying agentic execution. Operates as 50 sovereign Docker containers that compete for VRAM slices under real-time survival taxation, evolve neural topologies dynamically, and engage in trustless P2P weight exchange via smart contract escrow with 10x out-of-sample validation airgaps. Full 16-test verification suite (100% passed).

core_components: Warden Hypervisor — Dynamic MIG/MVS VRAM partitioning into Tier 1 (20GB), Tier 2 (4GB), Tier 3 (0GB) based on Sharpe ratio and max drawdown. Logarithmic + Stagnation survival tax (Tax_t = Tax_0 * (1 + alpha * ln(1 + t/60)) + beta * t_stagnant). SQLite ledger audits via isolated multiprocessing.Process with INSERT OR IGNORE logic bypassing Python GIL.

Zero-OOM Unified Memory Swapping — Exploits Grace Blackwell's 128GB Unified Memory over NVLink-C2C. Models pinned in host memory and swapped into CUDA execution units in microseconds without OOM crashes. Recklessness watchdog penalizes CUDA OOM containers -$10 and locks Tier 3 for 24 hours.

GPUDirect Storage (cufile) Streaming — KvikIODataForge streams partitioned LOB data directly from NVME drives into CUDA tensor memory without CPU bounce buffers. Zero-copy NVIDIA DALI batch loaders with double-buffer sequence batching.

Self-Modifying Architecture Engine — Dynamically swaps neural architectures (Transformer, Dilated-CNN-Seq2seq, Deep-Q scalper) to comply with assigned VRAM Tier memory limits. Hot-swap followed by gc.collect(), sys.modules clearing, and torch.cuda.empty_cache() sweeps.

Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) — Diagonal Fisher Information matrices across historical calibration datasets to penalize drift on critical alpha weights, eliminating catastrophic forgetting during continuous online adaptation.
Git Financial Rollback — Tags repository state at equity high-water marks. If drawdown exceeds 15%, instantly resets commits and weights back to high-water mark tag (git reset --hard).

Hindsight Experience Replay (HER) + Population-Based Training (PBT) — Converts failed execution sequences into positive training targets. Bottom 20% containers exploit and mutate top 20% parent hyperparameters.
Trustless P2P Escrow Bridge — Containers discover and purchase superior weights via decentralized social gossip. Atomically locks USDC cash during validation.

10x Validation Airgap — Sandboxes candidate weights across 10 historical flash-crash splits (2020-03-12, 2021-05-19, etc.). Requires Avg Sharpe >= 1.0 and Max Drawdown <= 15%. Failed transactions refunded 100% (REFUNDED).
optimization_highlights: 128GB Unified Memory NVLink-C2C: CPU and GPU share physical RAM over NVLink-C2C, enabling sub-microsecond tensor transfers without CUDA OOM crashes.
Phase 5 SOTA Master Orchestration: Reaper Protocol uses OS-level signal and atexit hooks to violently terminate vLLM and Warden subprocesses if script aborts, preventing zombie memory locks.
Strict Environment Masking: genesis_prime unsets CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES on itself, reserving 100% of VRAM for child containers and background vLLM reasoning server.
Idempotent Multiprocessing Audit: SQLite ledger audits via INSERT OR IGNORE logic in isolated OS-level multiprocessing.Process, doubling-dip taxation prevention during heavy load.
security_measures: Survival Tax Enforcement: Insolvent containers (equity <= $0 or cash <= -$50) are terminated and purged. Logarithmic tax increases over time, stagnation penalty for inactive agents.
CUDA OOM Recklessness Watchdog: Any container triggering CUDA OOM is instantly penalized -$10.00 and locked to Tier 3 for 24 hours.

10x Out-of-Sample Validation Airgap: Candidate model weights rejected if they fail to maintain Sharpe >= 1.0 or Max Drawdown <= 15.0 across 10 historical flash-crash splits. Automatic 100% refund on rejection.
Atomic P2P Escrow: USDC cash balance locked during validation, released only upon successful acceptance of candidate weights.

projects.title: ITFarmer / Neural Forge Hub
projects.description: A production-ready, cyber-brutalist Next.js 16 web application powering the Neural Forge Hub engineering studio. Features serverless AWS API Gateway + DynamoDB backend with zero S3 bucket dependency, a hardened admin CMS with password-protected mutations, client-side Base64 image pipeline for payload optimization, and a Groq Llama 3-powered AI assistant (ORBIT CORE) that aggregates all database context for real-time context-aware responses.

core_components: Serverless Data Layer — AWS API Gateway routes to DynamoDB tables (worksContent, postsContent, capabilities, about, faqContent, ecosystemContent, clientsContent). All images stored as Base64 JSON payloads with client-side resize + compression to bypass API payload limits (max 5MB upload).

Admin CMS (/admin) — Password-protected server-side admin panel with TypeScript CRUD operations. Uses Next.js Server Actions with revalidatePath for state mutations and 60-second ISR with tag-based on-demand cache invalidation.

ORBIT CORE AI Assistant — Chat API route (/api/chat) that injects complete database context (HERO, POSTS, CLIENTS, FAQ, ECOSYSTEM, SYSTEM_CONFIG) as structured JSON into Groq Llama 3 8B system prompt. Filters 'ORBIT CORE ONLINE' from message history to prevent sequence errors.
Base64 Image Pipeline — HTML5 Canvas client-side downscaling before upload, JPEG compression with configurable quality, and DynamoDB direct JSON storage. Eliminates S3 bucket configuration entirely.

Middleware Auth — Next.js middleware enforces admin authentication via environment variable password comparison. Server-side session handling with no client-side token storage. Fallback for local development when .env.local is missing.
Data Proxy (/api/data/[file]) — Serverless GET-only proxy with strict input validation (/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/ regex) preventing path traversal. 60-second ISR cache with filename-based tag invalidation.
optimization_highlights: Zero-S3 architecture: All images stored as Base64 directly in DynamoDB JSON payloads with client-side resize to bypass API Gateway 10MB limit.
ISR with tag-based invalidation: 60-second revalidate window with filename tags for atomic cache updates on data mutations.
Parallel DB context aggregation: Chat API fetches all 8 database tables concurrently via Promise.all for sub-1s response times.
Brutalist CSS optimization: Pure CSS Grid + Framer Motion with no external animation libraries, achieving 60fps transitions.
security_measures: Password-based admin auth with environment variable comparison (no client-side token storage).
Input validation on API data proxy: filename regex (/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/) prevents path traversal and injection.
Server Actions with revalidatePath for atomic state mutations with no race conditions.
5MB client-side upload validation before Base64 encoding and transmission.
60-second ISR caching prevents stale data exposure with tag-based on-demand invalidation.
